name: dl_message_arbiter
description: DL two-level message arbitration over external complete eligible messages; no encoder, FIFO or credit controller.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized full local RTL implementation and independent self-review. This bounded native internal interface is an implementation choice under that scope, not a user-specified wire layout.

behavior: One DWORD can be serviced at each asserted segment opportunity, with no extra arbitration latency. A segment opportunity is external, not implicitly every PHY clock.

Sources are complete-staged and eligible before pending. Each source presents its current DWORD; take consumes it and done retires its full message. Source order is the fixed catalog; word slices are 32*index +:32.
UART source7 presents the word addressed by o_uart_word_index, zero when idle. Total count2..33 includes header, captured only on first take. Non-UART sources are one word.

No payload/FIFO storage in this unit. Integration must bound external queues and meet the index-to-DWORD combinational access budget. The model/vector queues are two complete messages per source, not an RTL FIFO claim.
Round-robin within each group, then among Basic/Control/UART. Initial first priorities are Basic, source0/source5/source7. Advance both selected priorities only when the message completes.
UART transport retains ownership across all remaining words and unasserted segment cycles. No other UART, Basic or Control message may interleave.

Idle pending UART with count outside2..33 is excluded and raises combinational local error; other sources may progress. A locked owner withdrawing pending raises error, emits nothing, and retains ownership/index until restored or reset. These fault gaps are not legal wire transport behavior.
Reset suppresses all events and public locked/index observations combinationally; all internal state clears synchronously. It is a local block reset, separate from UART Stream Reset protocol.

Invalid event fields valid/word/source/word_index/last/take/done are zero; error and locked/index remain meaningful outside service opportunities. Captured UART length ignores subsequent count changes.
No wire encoding, UART credits/online/reset40NoOp handling, Basic outstanding restrictions or ACK deadlines implemented. No CDC in this single-clock unit.
constraints: Verilog2001, same-line Chinese semantic comments, one register per sequential always, complete combinational assignments, no raw clocks or RTL functions/tasks.
Clock frequency is a local characterization target; simulations at640/6400ps do not establish DL physical rate or timing closure.
Interface error is a local diagnostic, not a standard wire error code.
notes: Normative scope: DL/PL2.0 Table2-3 / section2.4.1.2 and section2.4.4.4 / Table2-14.
Encoded headers and source eligibility are trusted source contracts and need their own integration tests.
